name: Number to Words
description: Write numbers as RMB amounts in Chinese, Chinese numerals, English words, check amounts, Roman numerals and more
help: Type a number in any form: 1234.56, 1,234.56, 1.5万, 3e6, Chinese numerals such as 一亿二千万, an RMB amount such as 壹仟零肆元伍角, or a Roman numeral such as MCMXCIV. The kind of input is recognised automatically.
RMB uppercase follows the People's Bank of China writing rules: amounts are rounded to fen, 整 is added after 元 when there are no jiao or fen, and zeros are written once where digits are skipped.
English words use the US short scale without "and"; the check form writes cents as a fraction.
Roman numerals cover 1 to 3999. Byte sizes are shown in both binary (KiB) and decimal (kB) units.
Numbers are handled as exact decimal digits, so very long numbers and decimals keep every digit.
